rights.assessment: The publisher permits original creative edits of its game footage under its stated restrictions. Its policy does not convey any independent recordist's rights. Prefer our own original capture with music and chat disabled. Exclude any third-party audiovisual material without separate permission. Do not use the blueprint stills or promotional material in the cut.
